reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as stress-assisted precipitation of brittle phases like sigma in CoCrFeMnNi at 300–500°C is consistent with known thermodynamic tendencies and prior observations of embrittlement, though the exact kinetics and stress effect on local fluctuations remain debated.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, using in-situ synchrotron XRD and post-mortem TEM to detect precipitates and correlate with toughness loss, with a well-defined falsification criterion, though real-time detection of nanoscale compositional fluctuations may be challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful for researchers studying embrittlement in Cantor alloy, as it proposes a specific, testable mechanism with defined boundaries and a direct comparison to baseline, guiding targeted experiments.
